title: Album Cover with Rapper and Gritty Typography
coreRelationships: The central figure is positioned slightly to the left, creating an asymmetrical balance with the large title typography on the right.
The desaturated background contrasts with the vibrant red main title, drawing immediate attention to the text.
The distressed textures on the image and typography unify the overall gritty aesthetic.
The 'Parental Advisory' label acts as a distinct, high-contrast element in the lower right, anchoring that corner.
reuseFormula: Recreate the desaturated, gritty urban photo with a central figure. Overlay a large, distressed red custom-lettered title on the right. Add a clean, condensed white-on-black subtitle box below the title. Place a standard 'Parental Advisory' label in the bottom right.
